heading: It takes a team
text: Upward runs on volunteers. Give an hour a week, every other week, or whenever you can.

roles.title: Coach
roles.text: Love Jesus and want to make a difference in kids' lives? You don't need coaching experience, just a willingness to lead. We'll train and equip you. It's one practice and one game a week.

roles.title: Referee (paid and volunteer)
roles.text: We pay our referees, and we train them too. Open to adults, college students, and high schoolers. Experience in the sport helps but isn't required. Hours count toward National Honor Society and school service requirements.

roles.title: Game day team
roles.text: Set up and break down fields, help MC, and make Saturdays feel like a big deal.

roles.title: Mowing and field care
roles.text: Free during the week? Help mow and maintain the CCC sports fields.

roles.title: Communications and admin
roles.text: Help with parent communication, scheduling, and behind-the-scenes organization.

roles.title: Food trucks
roles.text: Run a food or refreshment truck? Game days draw big crowds that love supporting local businesses. We can't guarantee sales, but we'd love to have you.

quote: A coach will impact more people in one year than the average person will in an entire lifetime.

trainings.title: Flag football coach meeting and training

trainingsNote: Can't make a training? Sign up anyway. We'll make sure you're set up and supported.
